test_title: PYST 42: SSC MTS 2022 - English (Held On: 13 Jun, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is "Forciing." [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The correct spelling of the word is **"forcing"**, not **"forciing".** • The mistake in the spelling is the use of double **"ii"** instead of single **"i"** in the middle of the word. • The correct pronunciation of the word is **"for-sing".** • **"Forcing" **means to make something happen or to exert pressure on someone or something. (किसी को उसका अनचाहा काम करने के लिए विवश करना; बाध्य करना) • **Example**: *She is **forcing**__ me to quit my job.* • The correct answer is Option 4. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Shopping**: the act of buying goods from shops or stores. (दुकानों पर जाकर चीज़ ख़रीदने की क्रिया; ख़रीदारी) • **Trust**: belief in the reliability, truth, or ability of someone or something. (किसी पर विश्‍वास, भरोसा (उसके भला, ईमानदार आदि होने का निश्‍चय)) • **Wave**: a long body of water curling into an arched form and breaking on the shore. (लहर, तरंग (विशेषतः समुद्र में)) 43:Tc88, The correct answer is **"epic."**
